links.outcome: Repeatability of GPT-4V diagnoses across repeated runs on ocular images
links.effect: Overall repeatability of GPT-4V in diagnosing ocular images was 63.3% (38/60).
links.quote: The overall repeatability of GPT-4V in diagnosing ocular images was 63.3% (38/60).

links.outcome: Accuracy, usability and safety of GPT-4V responses on ophthalmic clinical tasks
links.effect: Of 600 responses, 30.6% accurate, 21.5% highly usable, 55.6% no harm; diagnosis accuracy 16.1%, decision support 24.0%.
links.quote: Out of 600 responses, 30.6% were accurate, 21.5% were highly usable, and 55.6% were deemed as no harm.

unlisted_practices: Automated sentence-similarity and GPT-4-based auto-evaluation compared with manual rating of LLM responses

screen.reason: The study benchmarks the clinical performance, accuracy, usability, and safety of GPT-4V on a dataset of ophthalmic multimodal images without evaluating an organizational deployment practice or guardrail.
